users.summary: Furo II is described as a nationwide shared academic resource, without a quantified user population.

priority_domains.summary: The launch material identifies simulation, data science, and AI as priority workload domains.

current_system.summary: Furo NEXT/Furo II was scheduled to begin service in October 2026 and was not yet operating at the evidence date.

refresh_window.summary: The next system was scheduled for an October 1, 2026 launch.

power.summary: No assigned Evidence establishes this field.

facility.summary: Both Furo II compute subsystems use water cooling and share a documented 37.44 PB effective Lustre store.

software.summary: The official installation page publishes the heterogeneous architecture and an extensive software environment.

operations.summary: Installation and launch timing are published; steady-state service evidence is not yet available.

migration.summary: Installation of the successor is documented, but workload migration status is not.

data_connectivity.summary: InfiniBand NDR and Nextcloud-based external access and collaboration are documented.
